title: Synthesis, DNA binding and biological evaluation of benzimidazole Schiff base ligands and their metal(ii) complexes.
authors: Mahmood, Khalid; Akhter, Zareen; Perveen, Fouzia; Aisha; Bibi, Muneeba; Ismail, Hammad; Tabassum, Nida; Yousuf, Sammer; Ashraf, Ahmad Raza; Qayyum, Muhammad Abdul
one_liner_zh: 该文合成苯并咪唑席夫碱配体及其金属配合物，通过分子对接和光谱实验研究其与DNA的结合，但对象为小分子-DNA互作而非蛋白质-DNA，且方法以实验为主、对接为辅，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: Two novel benzimidazole ligands (E)-2-((4-(1H-benzo[d]imidazole-2-yl)phenylimino)methyl)-6-bromo-4-chlorophenol (L(1)) and (E)-1-((4-(1H-benzo[d]imidazole-2-yl)phenylimino)methyl)naphthalene-2-ol (L(2)) with their corresponding Cu(ii), Ni(ii), Pd(ii) and Zn(ii) complexes were designed and synthesized. The compounds were characterized by elemental, IR, and NMR ((1)H & (13)C) spectral analyses. Molecular masses were determined by ESI-mass spectrometry, and the structure of ligand L(1) was confirmed by single crystal X-ray diffraction analysis. Molecular docking was carried out for the theoretical investigation of DNA binding interactions. The results obtained were verified experimentally by UV/Visible absorption spectroscopy in conjunction with DNA thermal denaturation studies. It was observed that ligands (L(1) and L(2)) and complexes (1-8) were moderate to strong DNA binders, as evident from the binding constants (K (b)). The value was found to be highest for complex 2 (3.27 x 10(5) M(-1)) and lowest for 5 (6.40 x 10(3) M(-1)). A cell line study revealed that breast cancer cells were less viable to the synthesized compounds compared to that of standard drugs, cisplatin and doxorubicin, at the same concentration. The compounds were also screened for in vitro antibacterial activity for which complex 2 showed a promising broad-spectrum effect against all tested strains of bacteria, almost in the proximity of the reference drug kanamycin, while the rest of the compounds displayed activity against selected strains.
abstract_zh: 设计并合成了两种新型苯并咪唑配体（E）-2-((4-(1H-苯并[d]咪唑-2-基)苯基亚氨基)甲基)-6-溴-4-氯苯酚（L(1)）和（E）-1-((4-(1H-苯并[d]咪唑-2-基)苯基亚氨基)甲基)萘-2-酚（L(2)）及其相应的Cu(ii)、Ni(ii)、Pd(ii)和Zn(ii)配合物。通过元素分析、红外光谱和核磁共振（(1)H和(13)C）光谱分析对化合物进行了表征。分子量通过ESI质谱法测定，配体L(1)的结构通过单晶X射线衍射分析确认。进行了分子对接以理论研究DNA结合相互作用。所得结果通过紫外/可见吸收光谱结合DNA热变性研究进行了实验验证。观察到配体（L(1)和L(2)）及配合物（1-8）为中等至强DNA结合剂，这从结合常数（K(b)）中得以体现。其中配合物2的值最高（3.27 x 10(5) M(-1)），配合物5的值最低（6.40 x 10(3) M(-1)）。细胞系研究表明，在相同浓度下，乳腺癌细胞对合成化合物的存活率低于标准药物顺铂和阿霉素。这些化合物还进行了体外抗菌活性筛选，其中配合物2对所有测试细菌菌株显示出有前景的广谱效果，几乎接近参考药物卡那霉素，而其余化合物则对选定菌株表现出活性。
